topic: Fuel-free sprinklers, Fine Mist splash touches, and Dew Cistern afterglow
currentUserGoal: Make Tiny Sprinklers work without Dew or other fuel, turn Fine Mist into a chance for sprinkler hits to touch surrounding tiles, and turn Dew Cistern into a stacking healing afterglow.
workCompleted: Removed every Tiny Sprinkler recipe input and allowed its outputs to overflow so a full resource buffer cannot pause automated touches.
Removed the obsolete dry-sprinkler state and rewrote first-automation guidance around permanent fuel-free operation.
Changed Fine Mist into a 6%-per-rank splash chance, up to 60%, that adds surrounding-tile touches while preserving bounded fixed-tick work on large fields.
Changed Dew Cistern into a four-second stacking sprinkler afterglow with rank-scaled healing and stack limits.
Added cyan Fine Mist rings, sprinkler feedback copy, afterglow HP-bar shimmer, Memory detail text, DOM accessibility readouts, and debug metrics.
Persisted the new afterglow and Fine Mist state with backward-compatible defaults for older active-field saves.
Updated the ecosystem design document and focused system/save tests for the new semantics.
Returned the local playtest save to a clean Run 1 after browser stress verification.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, Knip, 156 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.

Desktop 1280x720 browser stress check used a 100x100 field and twelve of every helper: Fine Mist procs accumulated, Dew Cistern held a 7.5 HP/s afterglow, Tiny Sprinkler reported no pause reason, fullFieldScans stayed at zero, and the sampled field held 144 FPS with zero frame spikes.

Phone 390x844 repeated the 100x100 stress check at 144 sampled FPS with zero frame spikes, zero full-field scans, bounded visible objects, active Fine Mist procs, active sprinkler afterglow, and no Tiny Sprinkler pause reason.
Browser console produced no warnings or errors.
knownIssues: Fuel-free Tiny Sprinklers strengthen early automation and may require another hands-on Scourge balance pass.
Fine Mist uses the exact average surrounding-tile count for the current field dimensions in the aggregate model; representative visual rings are capped and do not animate every logical tile.
Dew remains useful to the natural Moisture and Growth chain and Dawn Condensation still supplies that chain, but sprinklers never consume it.
The debug panel overlays content on a 390x844 viewport; this is confined to the debugPanel route.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and was not modified.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test Run 2 through early automation and tune sprinkler cadence, afterglow strength, and Fine Mist chance only from observed pacing.
Verify the Memory Grove descriptions and purchase celebration for Fine Mist and Dew Cistern at low ranks.
Push, deploy, and synchronize with the Mac only when requested.
doNotRevert: Do not restore Dew or any other production-resource input to Tiny Sprinkler recipes.
Do not let full Moisture, Care, or Growth buffers pause Tiny Sprinkler automated touches.
Do not restore the obsolete dry-sprinkler UI state.
Do not turn Fine Mist back into a generic touch/healing multiplier or Dew-efficiency rank.
Do not turn Dew Cistern back into Dew/Moisture storage.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
